# Cognolynx

> High-performance custom software engineering, modern digital products, and intelligent technology solutions.

Cognolynx is a modern software and product engineering company founded by Devakumar A. We design, architect, and build custom web applications, enterprise software systems, cross-platform mobile experiences, and AI-enabled workflows for forward-thinking businesses.

## Company Information
- Website: https://cognolynx.tech
- Founded & Led by: Devakumar A, Founder & Chief Executive Officer
- Contact Email: devak9391@gmail.com
- Mode: Remote-first engineering studio (originating in Puducherry, India)

## Core Service Capabilities
1. Custom Software Engineering: Tailored business applications, automated enterprise workflows, backend database architectures, and secure REST/GraphQL APIs.
2. Web & Digital Platforms: Modern frontend architectures using React, Next.js, and TypeScript, engineered for speed, conversion, and global scale.
3. Mobile Product Engineering: High-performance cross-platform iOS and Android applications developed using Flutter and React Native.
4. AI & Intelligent Systems: Applied machine learning, automated decision engines, computer vision pipelines, and intelligent operational agents.
5. UI/UX Design Systems: Cohesive design tokens, component libraries, and ergonomic user journeys.
6. Growth & Performance Marketing: Data-driven acquisition funnels, conversion rate optimization, and digital campaign infrastructure.

## Internship Program
Cognolynx operates a 1-month remote internship program designed for undergraduate and postgraduate students (B.E., B.Tech, BCA, MCA, B.Sc) seeking hands-on exposure to live production systems.
- Mode: 100% Remote / Online (open to eligible students across India).
- Duration: 1 month initial project sprint (with performance evaluation for stipend track extension).
- Cost: Training and project participation are free; an optional verified certificate of completion is provided with a nominal ₹149 processing fee.
- Stipend Policy: Initial 1 month is learning- and project-focused (unpaid); candidates demonstrating outstanding technical contribution are reviewed and selected for paid stipend internships.
- Available Domains:
  - Web Development (Frontend, Backend, Full-Stack, MERN)
  - Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (NLP, Computer Vision, LLMs)
  - Data Science & Analytics (Python, Power BI, Statistical Modeling)
  - Mobile App Development (Flutter, React Native, Android)
  - Programming & Software Engineering (Python, Java, Data Structures)
  - UI/UX & Product Design (Figma, Design Systems, Prototyping)
  - Database Management (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQL Optimization)
  - Software Testing & Quality Assurance (Automation, Selenium, API Testing)
  - Cloud Computing & DevOps (Docker, AWS, CI/CD Pipelines)
  - Cybersecurity & Ethical Hacking (Network Security, App Security)
- Application Link: https://cognolynx.tech/internship
